title: The AWS Public IPv4 Charge: Audit Every Address Before 1 February 2024
excerpt: From 1 February 2024 every public IPv4 address on AWS costs $0.005 an hour. An EC2 API audit that finds every address, names what holds it and marks what becomes chargeable, tested in moto: a ten-address demo account goes from $6.96 to $34.80 in February.
